notes: Live FortyGuard ingest: 4 of 4 grids fetched from the API.
The API does not report credit consumption in its response payload.
Temperatures arrive in Celsius and are converted to Fahrenheit at the client boundary.
API limitation: only filter_type 3 (forecast) succeeds on this key; 1, 2 and 4 return HTTP 500. The historic/forecast separation is still enforced in code.
API limitation: no hour-of-day parameter exists, so slices are forecast DAYS. Intra-day variation comes from the min/average/max each cell carries.
